zh: 红黑暗子混在一起，先由棋位一方操作；翻开后归真身颜色。翻出对方的子将了自己的军，翻子方立即判负。
en: Hidden red and black pieces are mixed. The slot's side controls the first move; the revealed color controls it afterward. Revealing an opposing piece that checks your own king loses immediately.
Ha! I captured my own piece!

zh: 哎呀，这一翻把自己输掉了！
en: Oops! That flip just lost the whole game!
Oh! It belongs to the other side.
That was one of our own.

zh: 啊，翻出来的子将了自己，这局结束了。
en: Oh… that reveal checked its own king. The game is over.
That piece belongs to the other side.

zh: 翻子将了自己，按规则这盘输了。
en: That reveal checked its own king. That is a loss.
